refund_policy.title: Refund Policy
refund_policy.intro: At Furnmasr, our goal is for you to receive the best quality products and be completely satisfied with your experience. If any problem occurs, you can rely on us to solve it easily.
refund_policy.first_section_intro: We accept return requests within 14 days from the date of receipt in the following cases:
refund_policy.condition_1: If the product arrived damaged or has a manufacturing defect.
refund_policy.condition_2: If you received a product different from the one in your order.
refund_policy.condition_3: If the product is unused and in new condition with all packaging and accessories.
refund_policy.exceptions_title: Products cannot be returned in the following cases:
refund_policy.exception_1: Products that have been used or opened (for reasons related to hygiene and personal care).
refund_policy.exception_2: Special offers or custom orders as per the customer's wish.
refund_policy.exception_3: Any product discounted as part of a "Sale".
refund_policy.second_section_title: Second: How to Submit a Return Request
refund_policy.contact_instruction: Send the order number + a photo showing the problem if the product is damaged or incorrect.
refund_policy.contact_response_time: We will review the request within 24–48 hours and get back to you with details.
refund_policy.refund_method: The amount will be refunded using the same payment method you used.
refund_policy.refund_duration: The duration is from 5 to 14 business days depending on the bank or financial intermediary.
refund_policy.refund_shipping_cost: Shipping costs are non-refundable (unless the error is on our part).
refund_policy.fourth_section_intro: In case you want to exchange the product instead of returning it:
refund_policy.exchange_step_1: Contact us, tell us which product you want to exchange, and send the product to us.
refund_policy.exchange_step_2: After inspecting it, we will send you the replacement as soon as possible.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.intro: At Furnmasr, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting all the data you share with us during your visit to the site or when placing an order.
privacy_policy.first_section_intro: We collect data that helps us provide a better experience, including:
privacy_policy.info_3: Payment data (without storing your bank card information).
privacy_policy.info_4: Usage data: Pages visited, time of visit, and device or browser type.
privacy_policy.second_section_title: Second: Why We Use Your Information?
privacy_policy.second_section_intro: We use your data for the following:
privacy_policy.usage_1: Processing your order, shipping it, and tracking its status.
privacy_policy.usage_2: Improving your experience on the site and developing the service.
privacy_policy.usage_3: Communicating with you in case of any problem or inquiry.
privacy_policy.usage_4: Sending offers or updates (optional and done with your consent).
privacy_policy.usage_5: Protecting the site and preventing any fraud attempts.
privacy_policy.third_section_intro: We do not share your data with any third party except in the following cases only:
privacy_policy.sharing_1: Shipping companies to deliver the order.
privacy_policy.sharing_2: Electronic payment gateways to complete transactions securely.
privacy_policy.sharing_3: Legal compliance authorities if officially requested.
privacy_policy.sharing_outro: Otherwise... your data is not sold or shared with any third party.
privacy_policy.fourth_section_intro: We use strong security measures to protect your data, such as:
privacy_policy.protection_1: Encryption of the connection between you and the site (SSL).
privacy_policy.protection_3: Limited access for company employees to the data.
privacy_policy.fifth_section_intro: The site uses cookies to improve your experience:
privacy_policy.cookies_1: Remembering products you added to the cart.
privacy_policy.cookies_2: Customizing content according to your preferences.
privacy_policy.cookies_3: Analyzing site performance to identify problems and improve them.
privacy_policy.cookies_outro: You can control or disable them from browser settings.
privacy_policy.rights_1: Request to know the data recorded with us.
privacy_policy.rights_2: Modify or delete any data belonging to you.
privacy_policy.rights_3: Unsubscribe from marketing messages at any time.
privacy_policy.seventh_section_intro: We may update the Privacy Policy from time to time, and any amendment will appear here on the page immediately.
privacy_policy.eighth_section_intro: If you have any question regarding privacy or data, you can contact us through:

exchange_policy.title: Exchange Policy
exchange_policy.intro: At Furnmasr, our goal is for you to receive products of the quality that suits you. If you need to exchange any product, we make the steps as easy as possible for you.
exchange_policy.first_section_intro: You can request a product exchange within 14 days of the receipt date in the following cases:
exchange_policy.condition_1: If the size or type is not suitable.
exchange_policy.condition_2: If the product arrived with a defect, scratch, or damage.
exchange_policy.condition_3: If you received a different product than what was in your order.
exchange_policy.condition_sub_intro: The product must be in its original condition:
exchange_policy.non_returnable_3: Custom orders made to customer's desire.
exchange_policy.steps_1: Contact customer service via WhatsApp or email.
exchange_policy.steps_2: Send the order number and a picture of the product (in case of a problem).
exchange_policy.steps_3: We will review the request within 24–48 hours and confirm the steps with you.
exchange_policy.shipping_1: In case of an error on our part (different/damaged product), shipping is fully on us.
exchange_policy.shipping_2: In case of size change or desire for a normal exchange, the customer bears the shipping cost.
exchange_policy.shipping_3: After receiving and inspecting the product, we will send the replacement immediately if it meets the conditions.
exchange_policy.duration_intro: The exchange process usually takes 5 to 10 business days depending on the shipping company and the region.
exchange_policy.contact_intro: If you have any inquiries or need help choosing a replacement product, customer service is available to help you at any time.

delivery_policy.title: Delivery Policy
delivery_policy.intro: At Furnmasr, our goal is for your order to reach you as quickly as possible and in the best condition. Here is everything related to the delivery process:
delivery_policy.delivery_scope_1: We provide delivery to all governorates of Egypt through approved shipping companies.
delivery_policy.delivery_scope_2: Some remote areas may require longer delivery time.
delivery_policy.delivery_time_intro: After we prepare your order within 24–48 hours, it is handed over to the shipping company.
delivery_policy.delivery_time_2: 2 to 5 business days within Egypt (may increase by a day during holidays, seasons, or remote areas).
delivery_policy.delivery_attempts_intro: The shipping company makes two delivery attempts:
delivery_policy.delivery_attempts_1: In case of no answer or unavailability, you will be contacted to schedule a new appointment.
delivery_policy.delivery_attempts_2: If delivery attempts fail, the shipment may return to the warehouse, and re-shipping will be done after confirming the address and charging additional cost if necessary.
delivery_policy.inspection_intro: We advise you to inspect the package before receiving it to ensure that:
delivery_policy.inspection_2: There is no damage or opening in the packaging.
delivery_policy.inspection_note: If you notice any problem, contact customer service within 24 hours of receipt.
delivery_policy.delays_1: If there is any delay from the shipping company or difficulty reaching you, our team will help you follow up until you receive the order.
delivery_policy.delays_2: We always monitor shipments to ensure they arrive on time.
delivery_policy.change_address_intro: If you would like to change the address after the order has been shipped:
delivery_policy.change_address_2: We will try to update it with the shipping company if there is still time.
delivery_policy.change_address_3: If the shipment has already moved, additional fees may be calculated according to the shipping company's policy.
delivery_policy.seventh_section_title: Seventh: In Case of Receiving Damaged Products
delivery_policy.damaged_products_intro: If the product arrived damaged or different:
delivery_policy.damaged_products_2: We will exchange it at our expense without any fees.
delivery_policy.contact_intro: If you have any inquiry regarding delivery, you can contact the support team via:

shipping_policy.title: Shipping Policy
shipping_policy.intro: At Furnmasr, we ensure your orders reach you quickly and in the best condition. Here is everything you need to know about shipping:
shipping_policy.processing_time_1: We process the order within 24–48 hours of receipt (business days only).
shipping_policy.processing_time_2: During peak times or seasons, processing time may increase by an additional day.
shipping_policy.shipping_time_1: 2 to 5 business days depending on the governorate and shipping company.
shipping_policy.shipping_time_2: Some remote areas may take an additional day.
shipping_policy.shipping_cost_1: Shipping cost appears before confirming the order.
shipping_policy.shipping_cost_2: In some offers or large orders, we may offer free shipping (depending on availability on the site).
shipping_policy.tracking_intro: As soon as your order is shipped, we will send you:
shipping_policy.tracking_outro: This is so you can track its journey moment by moment.
shipping_policy.receiving_1: Your presence or the presence of someone to receive on your behalf when the courier arrives
shipping_policy.receiving_2: Inspect the product upon receipt and ensure its condition
shipping_policy.receiving_note: If there is any problem, contact us directly within 24 hours.
shipping_policy.address_1: Ensure the shipping address is written correctly and clearly.
shipping_policy.address_2: If there is an error in the address and the shipment returns, re-shipping will be done after modifying the data and charging shipping costs again.
shipping_policy.delays_intro: If there is an unusual delay due to the shipping company or circumstances beyond our control, we will help you follow up on the order until it arrives.
shipping_policy.contact_intro: If you have any inquiry about your shipment, the customer service team is ready to help you at any time via:

data_deletion.title: Data Deletion Instructions
data_deletion.intro: According to the Facebook Platform rules, we have to provide Data Deletion Instructions. If you want to delete your activities for Furnmasr, you can remove your information by following these steps:
data_deletion.step_1: Go to your Facebook Account's Setting & Privacy. Click 'Settings'.
data_deletion.step_2: Look for 'Apps and Websites' and you will see all of the apps and websites you linked with your Facebook.
data_deletion.step_3: Search and Click 'Furnmasr' in the search bar.
data_deletion.outro: Congratulations, you have successfully removed your app activities and data from Furnmasr.
